Why this solution stands out

  • Designed for citizens, officers, and admins in one unified experience.
  • Supports bilingual and multilingual assistance with explainable AI outputs.
  • Helps departments reduce backlog with clear priorities and routing logic.
  • Built for a hackathon demo with a production-minded, service-oriented UI.

How the workflow works

1. Citizen reports an issue through the portal.
2. AI classifies the request and recommends a department.
3. Officer reviews the suggestion and approves or edits it.
4. Citizen receives updates and can track progress.
